paragraph: When preparing a cake, a recipe might call for 250 g of flour, 150 g of sugar, and 125 mL of milk. Since 1 cup is approximately 250 mL, 500 mL of milk is equivalent to 2 cups. If you need to convert 750 g of flour into kilograms, the result is 0.75 kg.

planted_errors.true_value: 500 mL is approximately 2.11 US cups (or 2.00 metric cups of 250 mL).

paragraph: A road trip from Toronto to Ottawa covers approximately 450 km. If you drive at an average speed of 100 km/h, the journey takes about 4.5 hours without stops. Converting 450 km into miles gives approximately 280 miles, while 100 km/h is equivalent to 62 mph.

planted_errors.true_value: Approximately 280 miles (450 km is about 279.6 miles).

paragraph: Weather forecasts often use Celsius and Fahrenheit to describe temperatures. A temperature of 20°C is equivalent to 68°F, while 30°C is equivalent to 86°F. If the temperature drops to 0°C, it becomes 32°F, and a freezing temperature of -10°C corresponds to 10°F.

When monitoring body weight, someone who weighs 70 kg weighs approximately 154 pounds. A person weighing 85 kg weighs about 187 pounds, while someone weighing 60 kg weighs approximately 132 pounds. To convert kilograms into pounds, multiply the weight in kilograms by approximately 2.205.

A rectangular bedroom measuring 4 m in length and 3 m in width has an area of 12 square metres. Since 1 square metre equals approximately 10.764 square feet, the bedroom covers about 129 square feet. If the ceiling is 2.5 m high, the room has a volume of 30 cubic metres.

A vehicle travelling at 90 km/h covers approximately 25 metres every second. If it maintains this speed for 2 hours, it travels 180 km. A speed of 120 km/h is equivalent to approximately 75 mph, which is a common highway speed in some countries.

When following a cooking recipe, 1 tablespoon is equivalent to 15 mL, while 1 teaspoon is equivalent to 5 mL. Therefore, 4 tablespoons of olive oil provide 60 mL, and 250 mL of water is equivalent to 1 metric cup. If a recipe requires 500 mL of broth, you can measure it using 2 metric cups.

A swimming pool measuring 8 m long, 4 m wide, and 2 m deep has a volume of 64 cubic metres. Since 1 cubic metre equals 1,000 litres, the pool can hold approximately 64,000 litres of water. A smaller container holding 500 litres has a volume of 0.5 cubic metres.

During winter, temperatures can fall significantly below freezing. A temperature of -20°C is equivalent to -4°F, while -30°C corresponds to -22°F. If the temperature rises to 10°C, it becomes 50°F, and a warm summer day at 35°C is equivalent to 95°F.

For a long-distance cycling trip, travelling 60 km in 2 hours means maintaining an average speed of 30 km/h. This is equivalent to approximately 18.6 mph. If a cyclist covers 15 km in 30 minutes, their average speed is 30 km/h, and completing a 120 km route at that pace would take 4 hours.
